summary: This 8-K filing by Hycroft Mining Holding Corporation discloses the results of an S-K 1300 Technical Report Summary and Initial Assessment for its Hycroft Mine in Nevada, along with a related press release and updated corporate presentation. The items are furnished under Regulation FD and Other Events, not filed. This is a routine technical disclosure with no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation event. The registrant is the issuer reporting standard mining technical data.
